skills.label: Developer
skills.description: Implement features, fix bugs, refactor code, or change tests in an existing repository. Verify the resulting behavior.

skills.label: Document Writer
skills.description: Apply when writing, explaining, summarizing, rewriting, or presenting user-facing answers and technical documents. Make content relevant, plain-language, concise, accurate, and easy for a non-developer to understand and review. This is a communication/output quality skill, not a document-planning workflow.

skills.label: Generate Flow
skills.description: Create an evidence-backed flow document when the user asks to trace, map, document, or generate an end-to-end flow for a specific feature. Do not trigger on a generic question about how code works when no document is requested.

skills.label: Git workflow
skills.description: Use when handling Git branches, commits, pushes, PR/MRs, merges, conflicts, releases, or worktrees. Load before every Git operation, including read-only checks; require explicit permission for commits and pushes.

skills.label: Reviewer
skills.description: Use only when reviewer is explicitly requested for code, technical documents, GitHub PRs, GitLab MRs, or a named workflow handoff.

skills.label: Solutions Architect
skills.description: Design or review solution architecture for software systems, infrastructure, cloud or on-premises deployments, data platforms, and system integrations. Use for architecture outlines, consequential design decisions, migrations, and implementation-readiness assessments.

skills.label: Task Creator
skills.description: Draft and create a new backlog task, ticket, or issue in a task tracker or an explicitly requested local file. Use when the user asks to create, log, or file new work; do not trigger for ordinary implementation requests or updates to an existing task.

skills.label: Tester
skills.description: Write unit, integration, and E2E tests, author feature-level E2E test case documents, or run and diagnose existing tests and interactive frontend checks.
